source: Sephiroth's forms on Cloud's ability IDs (Create a Character System 3.4): your playable Sephiroth (Cloud's rows, including the prologue's Cloud in Zack's SOLDIER outfit) has three forms, normal (Battle00), winged (Battle02 = the transformed Sephiroth's Battle00) and flying (Battle03 = his Battle01 wing moves, then his Battle00); the SephirothForms UE4SS mod switches them (hold Triangle in battle). His limits are Cloud's (level 1 Octaslash, 2 Heartless Angel, 3 Meteor: they unlock like Cloud's), the abilities Cloud's weapons give are his moves and switch with the form (weapon_abilities), and each form has its own 5 ATB commands. His rows load the transformed Sephiroth's effects (pack_assets) and the Fire/Blizzard/Thunder/Aero ability resources (preload). Goes with FullyPlayableSephirothDataAssets_P (his abilities, limits and rows) and SephirothForms_P (the built moves). KH2 form (Battle04): his Kingdom Hearts II moves; Meteor is cast with the KH2 sword raise in every form. Flying form (Battle03): his idle, walks, runs and turns from his flight in the final cutscenes. Flying form (Battle03): his idle, walks, runs and turns from his flight in the final cutscenes.
